svg.title: House Republicans elect Jim Jordan as their leader
svg.desc: Editorial illustration. From a low angle, Rep. Jim Jordan, lean with short brown-grey hair, in a white shirt and tie with no jacket, speaks into a cluster of reporters' microphones while reporters hold up phones and a camera operator films. Behind him, against a teal and coral dusk, a ribbon of blank folded ballot slips streams up and coils around a glowing Capitol dome, symbolising the secret ballot in which House Republicans chose him as their leader on Nov. 10, 2026.
